name: 1social-x
description: An X (Twitter) posting workflow for the 1Social connector: write a tweet or a thread that fits 280 characters per post, attach images, check it against X's limits, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Write and publish tweets and threads on X (formerly Twitter) without leaving the chat. Share an idea, a draft or an article, and get a tweet that fits 280 characters, or a thread where each post stands on its own and the first one makes people open the rest. Add images, check every post against X's limits before anything goes out, then publish now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the post actually landed, with a link to it. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need an X account connected to your 1Social account.
defaultPrompt: Write a tweet announcing our launch and post it to X.
Turn this article into a Twitter thread and schedule it for tomorrow at 9am.
Shorten this text into a tweet that fits 280 characters and publish it.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: guided tweets, threads and scheduling on X over the 1Social connector.
